title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1982-04-06

ai_review.summary: A stunning matrix capture of a spring‑1982 Philadelphia show – crystal‑clear sound and the band on fire with a smoking Shakedown/​Crazy Fingers tease.
ai_review.review: The matrix recording is repeatedly praised as “beautiful” and “amazing,” indicating an excellent blend of board and audience sources that preserves clarity and ambience. Reviewers rave about the energy of the night, especially the quick Crazy Fingers tease during Shakedown Street, describing the band as being on fire in Philadelphia.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are 5‑star and highlight both a superb musical performance and an exceptional matrix recording, giving the show near‑perfect combined quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers call it “beautiful,” “amazing,” and the best version they’ve heard, indicating a clean, well‑balanced mix with no noted flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic and tight; the band maintained high momentum throughout the night, especially in the Philadelphia set.
